title:
Luxury rooms,
made for you.
pageSubline: Four room types, all with free WiFi, 24hrs service, breakfast room service, free parking and equipped kitchens.

room.reserveBody: Reserve instantly through our booking engine — no prepayment required. Confirmation is sent immediately with your booking details.
points: Pay at the hotel — no prepayment

deluxe-room.name: Deluxe Room
deluxe-room.description: Deluxe room, king size bed, 1 bathroom and 2 seats and small table — it is for business guest. A/C, Kitchen, microwave, stove, cupboard.

one-bed-room-apartment.name: One Bed Room Apartment
one-bed-room-apartment.description: Bed room apartment — bed room & living room, bath room, kitchen (fridge, stove, microwave, kettle, etc).

executive-two-bed-room.name: Executive Two Bed Room
executive-two-bed-room.description: Two bed room — master room with king bed separate bathroom & twin bed room with bathroom and living room, equipped kitchen (stove, fridge, microwave, kettle, cutlery, etc).

deluxe-two-bed-room.name: Deluxe Two Bed Room
deluxe-two-bed-room.description: Deluxe two bed room — two separate rooms, two bath rooms, kitchen, master room have king size bed and separate bathroom inside, panorama view.
